WATCH: Chinese state broadcaster CCTV has released footage that appears to show a ballistic missile hitting a full-scale mock-up of a U.S. aircraft carrier at a desert test range in Xinjiang.
The missile was a DF-26B, the anti-ship variant of the PLA Rocket Force’s Dongfeng-26.
The road-mobile DF-26 can carry nuclear or conventional warheads, has a reported range of 3,000–5,000+ km, and is often called the “carrier killer.”

Jake Sullivan:
I believe in a secure, democratic Jewish state of Israel living in peace and security with an independent Palestinian state, with rights for all and equal citizenship for all in both of those states.
That outcome is something that you ought to be able to get broad-based consensus on from every country in the world.
And we should get back to trying to find a way forward that produces that vision for the Middle East.

Jake Sullivan:
A war over Taiwan would be catastrophic for everybody.
That's why we have to prevent it.

Jake Sullivan:
When we came in, China basically tried to tell us: "You have to choose. We're either going to compete or we're going to cooperate, and if you choose to compete, then there'll be no cooperation."
And we said, "I'm sorry, but it doesn't work like that. You have to be able to do both at once."

Jake Sullivan:
We are a constitutional republic rooted in a creed that Abraham Lincoln, I think, really first crystallized in lifting the Declaration of Independence and particularly its preamble to preeminence as the ultimate story of America.
That has not changed, whatever Curtis Yarvin or the Palantir guys or the Dark Enlightenment guys say.
Trying to replace that fundamental idea, I think, won't work because I think it's deeply embedded in the American spirit.

Jake Sullivan:
We should be working with like-minded democracies around the world to try to make the world a better place.
Now, we shouldn't do it through wars of regime change.
I believe that we did and should again turn the page on the post-9/11 wars.

Indian opposition leader Rahul Gandhi:
For years and years, votes have been stolen in this country.
Votes were stolen by deleting people from and adding people to voter lists.
Fifteen percent of India's voters were removed from the voter lists after the 2024 elections.
This means the 2024 election was an illegal election.
It was a stolen election.

U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee:
Netanyahu will remain in power as prime minister until another government is formed.
It certainly won't happen until at least 42 days. It could be much more than that.
There may not be any transition at all.

U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee:
On the issue of national security, there's not much difference between any of the parties, other than perhaps the Arab parties.
There is no left wing to speak of left in Israel after October the 7th. That sort of vaporized.

Indian opposition leader Rahul Gandhi:
Farmers are not getting their rights. Young people are not getting jobs. Workers are not getting their rights.
And the entire wealth, all the wealth, has gone into the hands of two or three people.
We do not want such an India. And we will not accept such an India.
